_notice: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Fictional policies for the Trust Bridge demo.

policies.title: Consent gates every bridge
policies.rule: Health data may leave the patient workspace only across a bridge with an active consent whose scope covers the data being sent.
policies.maps_to: Purview data loss prevention and sensitivity labels, enforced before send or write

policies.title: Patient approves outbound messages
policies.rule: Any message sent on the patient's behalf requires an explicit patient approval recorded before delivery.

policies.title: Workforce agents get the minimum
policies.rule: Workforce agents may receive scheduling data only. Clinical values never cross to a workforce agent.
policies.maps_to: Approved resources and least privilege for the agent identity
